text: # masa - doc - 001 : condor module — technical operations manual # # module overview and primary function the condor module serves as the command and control hub for all station operations aboard kuntur station, operating in low earth orbit at a high altitude. designed to accommodate two crew members — specifically the station commander and pilot — condor integrates critical systems including ventilation, heating, lighting, cooling, and filtration to maintain optimal environmental conditions for continuous operational readiness. as the central nervous system of the station, condor processes telemetry from all connected modules, executes orbital maneuvers, and coordinates communication windows with masa ground stations. the module's primary function extends beyond mere environmental control ; it houses the main flight control workstations, navigation systems, and station - wide monitoring interfaces that enable real - time decision - making for both routine operations and emergency scenarios. the architectural design of condor prioritizes redundancy in command pathways, with triple - modular redundancy in critical flight systems to ensure uninterrupted control even during partial system failures. this redundancy architecture directly supports the module's role as the primary interface for orbital adjustment maneuvers ( masa - ops - 007 ) and communication window management ( masa - ops - 008 ).
